name: Cleaner Core

repository.note: The public repository. Grok clones it only to read CLEANER_CORE_BOOTSTRAP.md and these files. It never runs Cleaner Core from the clone.

integrations.name: Cleaner Core
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.1 discovered from the Cleaner Core service. The owner clicks Allow. Grok cannot approve itself.

integrations.name: Google Calendar
integrations.auth: The host connects their own Google account to Grok's built-in Google Calendar connector. Grok reads the events and passes them to Cleaner Core. Cleaner Core never gets a Google approval.

routines.name: Cleaner Core Check
routines.schedule: Every 5 minutes for a demo, and hourly otherwise.

ships: the bot profile and standing instructions
the Cleaner Core Check and Cleaner Core Alerts routine definitions
neverShips: the Alerts routine's webhook address or token
marketplace.activation: A new host pastes the prompt, connects to the hosted Cleaner Core named by hostedCleanerCoreUrl, and clicks Allow once. They never run a server.

neverIncluded: the Alerts routine's webhook address or token
Cleaner Core connector or OAuth tokens
Google OAuth access or refresh tokens
host, cleaner, or contact phone numbers
live booking, cleaning, message, or photo records
